## Analysis

sol_0044 shows that a 512-cell, three-digit mixed-radix search is too diffuse: despite slice moves and strong small seeds, it never improved the fallback. This refutes dimensionality alone as the missing ingredient. Earlier tensor gains came from compact, highly correlated cell patterns, while unrestricted masks repeatedly stagnated. The next search should therefore preserve algebraic regularity while combining the strongest 66-point seed with tensor-style projection.
